thread_text:
Ana P: Quick sync  propose a narrow private-deploy launch slice focused on: 1) 3 egress presets customers can opt into, 2) a preflight validator that does not flip traffic, 3) a canary+drain upgrade with automated rollback. Keep phase 1 CLI/installer-only.

Victor H: +1 keep it minimal. Suggested presets: `nat-relay`, `bgp-peer`, `preserve-egress-ip`. Add `managed-nat` alias for locked-down environments.

Kaseem J: We need a concrete preflight checklist: IP routability check, overlapping-prefix detection, BGP origin acceptance (ASN match), and an egress smoke request that verifies observed src IP. Dry-run mode must not change control plane state.

Ana P: Installer flag sketch (phase 1):
``
--egress-mode=nat-relay|bgp-peer|preserve-egress
--preserve-egress-ip=198.51.100.11/32
--bgp-asn=65100
--upgrade-canary=0.1
--drain-seconds=120
--egress-validate-only
```
Default to `nat-relay`.

Victor H: Upgrade flow: pick canary subset -> run smoke harness (http e2e + egress-ip check + control-plane auth) -> drain -> ramp. If smoke fails -> immediate rollback. CLI example: `redwood-operator upgrade --canary 10% --drain 120s`

Kaseem J: Error codes for field handoff: `EGRESS_IP_IN_USE`, `BGP_NOT_ACCEPTED`, `ROUTE_NOT_ADVERTISED`. Make messages actionable with next steps.

Ana P: Launch gating (proposal): docs + runbook, two pilots validated (MapleBank & CobaltAI) across nat & preserve flows, staging canary+rollback exercise completed, telemetry: egress_validation.status + upgrade.canary.result, security signoff for KMS/HSM where requested.

Victor H: I'll own the test harness and smoke checks (ETA 2 sprints). Kaseem can draft the onboarding template (ASN, prefix, peering window, emergency contact). Ana will own pilot comms and launch criteria.

Kaseem J: Onboarding template will include a short netops checklist and a troubleshooting FAQ (stateful NAT tips, asymmetric routing symptoms). I'll also add a required field to capture if preserved IPs are customer-owned public IPs.

Ana P: infra-bot, please file follow-ups for: egress preflight validator, smoke harness, and telemetry events.

infra-bot: Created tickets INFRA-15001 (egress preflight validator), INFRA-15002 (smoke harness), TELE-502 (egress_validation.status & upgrade.canary.result). Assigned to @Victor H and @Kaseem J, due next sprint.

Victor H: Note: phase 1 intentionally excludes console UI. If pilots succeed we'll map presets into Console in phase 2 and add per-tenant rollout controls.

release-bot: Planned staging dry-run: 2024-05-03T03:00:00Z (dry-run).

Ana P: Thanks all. Narrow scope, clear gates, pilot owners assigned. We'll reconvene after dry-run and update roadmap ticket.
